premise: The wind wants to play with everything in the forest, tickling leaves and petals, and nobody can catch it, until everyone sits still and it curls up in the grass.
inspiration: The North Wind and the Sun (Aesop), turned: the wind is a playmate, not a rival, and stillness, not chasing, is what calms it.
lesson: Some things cannot be caught, only calmed by being calm.

en-US.title: The Wind Comes to Play
en-US.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.4} One morning the wind woke up in a playful mood. {sfx:wind} Whoosh! It ran through the forest looking for someone to play with. It tickled the tree. {tree:wobble x2} Rustle rustle rustle went every leaf. {sfx:rustle solo} It puffed at the flower. {flower:wobble} Her petals went flap, flap, like a tiny flag. It rolled the pinecone {pinecone:spin} round and round, and it sent the butterfly {butterfly:spin} in a loop-the-loop. [laughs] Everyone tried to catch it. The tree reached. The flower stretched. The butterfly chased. But you cannot catch the wind. Nobody can! [curious] So what did they do? They sat very still. They kept very quiet. And the wind… slowed… down. {sfx:wind} Whoosh… whoo… It curled up in the long grass like a sleepy kitten. [softly] And the forest patted it, softly, and let it sleep.

es-ES.title: El viento viene a jugar
es-ES.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.4} Una mañana el viento se despertó con ganas de jugar. {sfx:wind} ¡Fiuuu! Corrió por el bosque buscando con quién jugar. Le hizo cosquillas al árbol. {tree:wobble x2} Chas, chas, chas, cantaban todas las hojas. {sfx:rustle solo} Le sopló a la flor. {flower:wobble} Sus pétalos bailaron flap, flap, como una banderita. Hizo rodar a la piña {pinecone:spin} vueltas y vueltas, y a la mariposa {butterfly:spin} la mandó a hacer el rizo. [laughs] Todos intentaron cogerlo. El árbol estiró las ramas. La flor se puso de puntillas. La mariposa lo persiguió. Pero al viento nadie lo coge. ¡Nadie! [curious] ¿Y qué hicieron entonces? Se quedaron muy quietos. Muy callados. Y el viento… fue… frenando. {sfx:wind} Fiuuu… fiu… Se hizo un ovillo en la hierba alta, como un gatito con sueño. [softly] Y el bosque lo arropó despacito y lo dejó dormir.

wind.prompt: a soft playful gust of wind whooshing past, rising then fading

rustle.prompt: a breeze shaking the leaves of one big tree, a lively rustle that settles
